lead: Mahendra Singh Dhoni has built a public profile as an Indian cricketer, born on 7 July 1981 in Ranchi.
As of 2026, he is 45 years old, and his birth date places him under the Cancer sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Chennai Super Kings and has been recognised with CNN-News18 Indian of the Year and Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in Sports and Games.
This profile collects the Mahendra facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
